dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about this "President" of yours...

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: Well, "former President" now, to be exact. I mean, he's gone... I just keep calling him the President out of plain habit.

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: Old man Izmaylov lived for a real long time. Sometimes, he'd even tell us stories about how Snezhnaya used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Zybina
dialogues.text: ...Sadly, we won't be hearing those stories anymore.
